activity.notes: ATLAS uses 1967 as García Márquez's representative Mexican literary milestone year. He was living and writing in Mexico City during the creation of One Hundred Years of Solitude, whose 1967 publication transformed him into an internationally celebrated writer.

sources.title: Gabriel García Márquez: The Making of a Global Writer — Harry Ransom Center, University of Texas
sources.citation_text: The Harry Ransom Center records García Márquez living in Mexico City in 1965 while writing One Hundred Years of Solitude and identifies its 1967 publication as the breakthrough that made him globally celebrated.
